name: Deluge Curveback
description: Stand with a stick in each hand and the weight even like a hawk with both wings folded.

name: Inferno Circling
description: Loose both sticks in the same breath along two gentle arcs that part and then meet.

name: Peal Wingarm
description: Count the beats of each return aloud so both catches fall on the same measure.

name: Pealwood
description: Cast one stick at either side of the foe so both flanks must be guarded together.

name: Reminiscence Trailingedge
description: Flick one stick high as bait while the second skims low to take the foe's attention.

name: Statute Sweptwing
description: Cross the sticks at the forearms and brace them against a heavy blow with qi.

name: Pulsarwood
description: Drop both sticks from a high arc onto the foe at the same moment.

name: Radiance Returnarc
description: Fly both sticks round the foe and pull them in until the guard is pinched between.

name: Elbowbend Heraldry
description: Streak after the pair of sticks to the far end of their arcs and receive them there.

name: Matchless Woodgrain
description: The school's first great cast sends the two sticks wheeling apart then falling together on the foe's guard.

name: Vigor Crookend
description: Stand with feet apart as on two banks and the stick held low across the body.

name: Leadingedge Decree
description: Draw a crescent stick from each shoulder strap in a single outward sweep.

name: Pealcurve
description: Pick out the bend in the foe's line of approach and judge where the crescents will curve.

name: Prism Cycle
description: Send the crescent out in a bend like a river's and let it return along the opposite bank.

name: Millstone Tipwing
description: Spin the crescent round a foe's legs like an eddy and keep it turning to hold them.

name: Prism Crookend
description: Throw a looping flight with two turns that meanders around cover and finds the foe.

name: Arcdecree
description: Hold a crescent in each hand and rake one then the other across the foe's guard.

name: Dunecycle
description: Cast the crescents wide so they sweep the low ground like a flood across a plain.

name: Squallreturn
description: Close two crescents on a single foe from opposite curves of the river.

name: Steelcycle
description: Drive both crescents through the same line so their combined edge shears through a shield.

name: Curvetriumph
description: The school's crescent follows the river's bend and brings the foe into the basin where it ends.

name: Squallcycle
description: Hold the sticks one in front of the other like two courtiers waiting to be called.

name: Inferno Sweptwing
description: Wind both arms in opposite circles to build the beat of the two-winged throw.

name: Stately Return
description: Advance in a measured stately pace with the sticks carried ready at the hips.

name: Reminiscence Returnarc
description: Take each returning stick on the same side hand it left with the palm facing up.

name: Squall Elbowbend
description: Throw the first wing out and the second in its wake to cover the first's return.

name: Masterful Loopback
description: Cross the two flights at the foe's chest so a lunge is checked before it starts.

name: Tipwing Seal
description: Meet a strike with both sticks edge to edge and turn it clear of the body.

name: Illustrious Hover
description: Bank both sticks in wide opposing sweeps to press a group of foes against one another.

name: Dauntless Trailingedge
description: Let the first wing break a guard and the second wing land the blow that decides.

name: Beguiling Leadingedge
description: Cast both wings in a lane so the court closes behind any who enter it.

name: Radiance Curveback
description: Cast the pair and arrive between them at the moment they cross the mark.

name: Squall Loopback
description: The court's signature throw has each wing cover the other's return so neither ever leaves a gap.

name: Pealgrain
description: Set two tracks in the mind with the foe at the point where they will close.

name: Thunderclap Arc
description: Draw the throwing arm across the chest to set the arc that tightens at its end.

name: Curvegrace
description: Pace out the distance in even strides until it matches the reach of both tracks.

name: Graincrown
description: Cast an arc that tightens as it nears the foe and ends against the chest.

name: Entropy Woodgrain
description: Cut one track across the other at the foe's feet so they cannot step either way.

name: Steadfast Woodgrain
description: Hold both tracks close to the body as a ring of whirling wood the blows cannot cross.

name: Pulsarcycle
description: Bring the two tracks together on the foe's shield arm and crush it between them.

name: Snaring Crookend
description: Lay both tracks across a lane so a foe who runs through meets them closing from either side.

name: Imperial Arc
description: Drive the second track through the opening the first has made in a braced guard.

name: Matchless Circling
description: The school's closing arc narrows both tracks on the foe until no direction of retreat remains.

name: Vigor Hover
description: Turn slowly on one foot with the arms spread as a hawk wheels on the air.

name: Wise Curveback
description: Feel through the qi field where warm air rises and plan the stick's climb upon it.

name: Squallgrain
description: Let go at the top of a turning step so the stick leaves already climbing in a spiral.

name: Majestic Wingarm
description: Hold the stick wheeling overhead in the field and choose the moment it falls.

name: Unyielding Sweptwing
description: Keep the stick circling above the head so missiles from the front are knocked from the air.

name: Sigil Cycle
description: Drop the stick's crook upon a foe's shoulder and drag them down as if in a talon.

name: Hover Edict
description: Cast several sticks from a raised position so they fall steeply on a distant line.

name: Cyclebanner
description: Break the wheel at its height and plunge the stick onto a foe's unguarded crown.

name: Artful Leadingedge
description: Cast sticks to wheel in layers over a field so the air above it becomes a net of cuts.

name: Season Return
description: Rise onto the wheel's current and dart across the field to the stick's landing point.

name: Prismreturn
description: The school's great cast wheels high and then stoops on the foe with all the hawk's weight.

name: Peal Elbowbend
description: Seat the breath low in the belly and feel the Core hum with the stick's beat.

name: Cycletriumph
description: Draw out a stick and sweep a full circle with it about the body before the cast.

name: Tipwing Boon
description: Move so lightly that the Core's balance never wavers from the center of the ring.

name: Pealbark
description: Take the stick on the same spot of the circle from which it was loosed.

name: Peerless Loopback
description: Throw the stick in an ever-widening ring that touches the foe at every point of its path.

name: Thrall Trailingedge
description: Narrow the ring about a foe by degrees until the circle presses their arms to their sides.

name: Hospitable Wingarm
description: Feed the Core's qi to the stick's orbit so its speed and edge both grow with each circuit.

name: Famed Returnarc
description: Burst the orbit outward so every foe near the thrower is driven back at once.

name: Statute Crookend
description: Cast many rings nested within one another until the field becomes a maze of cutting circles.

name: Splendid Return
description: Split the orbit in two at the height of its circuit and let both halves fall across a crowd.

name: Gallant Hover
description: Return the orbit through the same breach again and again until the strongest guard is torn.

name: Storied Trailingedge
description: The school's apex ring turns unbroken about the field so nothing within it escapes the circle.

name: Barkgift
description: Recite the first line of the oath aloud and turn the face to the bearing it names.

name: Bedrock Loopback
description: Plant the front foot toward the wind and the rear foot square to the throw.

name: Radiance Cycle
description: Loose the stick so level that the oath has nothing to correct in its first reach.

name: Woodgrain Mercy
description: Take the stick home along the bearing in the hand that first threw it.

name: Peal Arc
description: Cast along the first sworn bearing so true that the stick needs no correction.

name: Thrall Circling
description: Swing the stick's crook on a gust round a foe's arm and tighten it with a tug.

name: Leadingedge Troth
description: Hold the stick edge-on so a gust helps turn a blow out and past the body.

name: Valiant Tipwing
description: Keep the stick hissing past the foe's face along the bearing so they dare not advance.

name: Woodtriumph
description: Return two sticks along one bearing so the second strikes as the first leaves.

name: Cunning Elbowbend
description: Cast sticks on the wind to circle a stretch of ground and strike whoever crosses.

name: Interstice Curveback
description: Cast the stick and arrive at the end of the bearing in the instant it lands.

name: Returntriumph
description: The oath's first bearing holds the stick through every wind so it strikes where it was sworn to.

name: Squall Wingarm
description: Stand easy on open ground with the sticks hung at the hips and the eyes on the horizon.

name: Barkmercy
description: Mark the spot on the ground where the stick is sworn to come down.

name: Radiance Circling
description: Cast flat and low across the plateau so the gale cannot lift the stick from its line.

name: Radiance Arc
description: Throw so the stick returns to the marked spot and strikes whoever stands on it.

name: Imperious Return
description: Loop the stick about a foe standing on the mark and hold them there to the end.

name: Returnarc Reliquary
description: Meet a thrown stone with the wing edge and let the gust finish its turning.

name: Tempestuous Sweptwing
description: Cast the stick wide so its sworn return sweeps the whole standing ground.

name: Returnedict
description: Keep the stick flying along the line of an advance until the front rank halts.

name: Destiny Crookend
description: Return the sworn stick so its edge cuts through any worn protection the foe relies on.

name: Sovereign Curveback
description: The plateau's sworn return strikes twice upon the marked ground and comes home to the hand.

name: Splendid Trailingedge
description: Hold the stick with the cutting edge forward and the thumb along the flat.

name: Windborne Cycle
description: Lean into the gale and walk against it with the weight forward and the knees soft.

name: Woodmercy
description: Run a thumb along the wing edge each morning and swear to keep it straight and true.

name: Cycleedict
description: Throw the edged stick straight into the gale so it parts the wind and cuts through.

name: Inferno Cycle
description: Turn the stick on its edge at the far end so it slices back through the same wind.

name: Bedrock Wingarm
description: Hold the stick like a hatchet and bring it down on a foe's weapon with the oath's weight.

name: Thrallreturn
description: Wrap the stick's crook about a foe's blade and pull the edge down and away.

name: Cycleverdict
description: Return the edge along the gale so it cuts a raised shield and the arm behind it.

name: Retribution Returnarc
description: Cast edged sticks into a gale so a stretch of ground becomes a net of whistling cuts.

name: Hover Decree
description: Return the sworn edge so its cut passes through plate and flesh as though through cloth.

name: Thunderclap Return
description: The school's edged stick parts the gale and rides the gap it makes through any guard.

name: Grainbenison
description: Read the slope and the loose stone of the plateau before standing to throw.

name: Heroic Sweptwing
description: Take a wide stride and release at its end with every muscle of the body behind it.

name: Evanescent Tipwing
description: Fall back over open ground in short steps while keeping the throwing line toward the foe.

name: Eclipse Woodgrain
description: Take the returning stick in a closed hand without losing the bearing of the next cast.

name: Dauntless Arc
description: Cast far over bare ground where the foe has no cover and the stick no obstruction.

name: Fettering Loopback
description: Send the stick round a foe's legs along a held bearing and tighten it as it returns.

name: Nightmare Elbowbend
description: Skim the stick to kick up dust that hides the real cast flying a moment behind.

name: Curveback Triumph
description: Ride the returning stick on a gust that carries it past the guard and into the back.

name: Demolition Leadingedge
description: Cast many sticks across the open ground to fall upon a whole line of foes in turn.

name: Barkdecree
description: Hold the stick on one bearing in a blur of back-and-forth flight so no foe may cross.

name: Silken Elbowbend
description: Cast along the bearing and cross the bare ground to the stick's landing in a single streak.

name: Paramount Wingarm
description: The plateau's full bearing throw unfolds across the open ground and leaves no foe in cover.

name: Revelation Woodgrain
description: Fix the eye upon the horizon and reckon how far over it the stick must go to return.

name: Thunderclap Circling
description: Swing the arm in a long slow circle gathering the whole body's force for a great cast.

name: Delugereturn
description: Let the qi field sink through the legs into the ground and root the feet there.

name: Famed Tipwing
description: Send the stick out beyond the foe's sight and let it come back from behind.

name: Peal Return
description: Recall the stick at the instant a foe commits to a thrust so it strikes their rear.

name: Prism Sweptwing
description: Hold the stick before the chest so the field's wind carries blows past the body.

name: Crookend Edict
description: Cast to the far line of sight and have the stick strike and return across the whole span.

name: Tempestuous Leadingedge
description: Cast the stick so its return sweeps back over every foe who advanced beneath its flight.

name: Thunderclap Hover
description: Cast the stick over the rim and flash across the distance to meet it on the other side.

name: Illustrious Trailingedge
description: The long return sends the stick over the horizon and recalls it to strike a foe from behind.

name: Hospitable Woodgrain
description: Breathe with the gale until the Core's pulse and the wind's beat run together.

name: Prismcurve
description: Draw a circle in the air about the thrower with the stick before loosing it.

name: Bedrock Returnarc
description: Root the feet beneath the Core and stand fast where the ring will turn about the body.

name: Pulsar Arc
description: Throw the stick in a great circle that the gale itself helps to carry about the field.

name: Masterful Circling
description: Draw the ring tighter about a foe until the whirling stick holds them to the spot.

name: Solar Curveback
description: Feed the Core's qi to the ring so the orbit's wind grows and its edge sharpens.

name: Volition Sweptwing
description: Burst the ring outward on a gust and drive every foe near the thrower a pace back.

name: Shrewd Crookend
description: Cast several rings into a gale until the ground inside is a lattice of whistling cuts.

name: Curvedecree
description: Break the ring over a crowd so its pieces fall and tear along the gale's course.

name: Animaarc
description: Return the ring through one point until the wind and the edge undo any protection there.

name: Illustrious Loopback
description: The apex ring turns on the gale about the whole field and leaves no corner out of its reach.
